author: GameSpot
description:
It's been kind of a long time since we had a proper new Batman action game that solely focused on the caped crusader--more than a decade, in fact, as 2015's Arkham Knight was the most recent one. But that's going to change with Lego Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight. I had the chance recently to get about two hours of hands-on time with this new Lego Batman epic, and it feels as much like a new Arkham game as it does a new Lego Batman game.
